title: IPU documents released to Tim Cooper

tellings.quote: interplanetary phenomenon unit documents that were I think released in 1994 1995 to Tim Cooper from uh a pseudonym Thomas Kwell

plain: Papers about the Interplanetary Phenomenon Unit, said to be a military team that dealt with UFO matters, were released around 1994 or 1995 to a researcher named Tim Cooper by someone using the false name Thomas Kwell. The researcher who goes by UAPGerb mentions this from memory, saying they were "I think released in 1994 1995." If real, the papers would show a hidden official unit handling UFO cases.
